Registered Auditors · Zuidplein 140, 1077 XV Amsterdam, Netherlands
A U D I T O R ' S F I L E C O P Y · I S S U E D T O T H E E N T I T Y ' S F I N A N C E F U N C T I O N
Report on Agreed-Upon Review Procedures
Classification review · Altai Metals Holding B.V.
Entity
Altai Metals Holding B.V.
Account
ACC-7604
Report number AR-2025-0106
Issued by
Amstel Audit Partners B.V.
This report records the outcome of the classification review procedures performed on selected
transactions of the Entity for the period. It is issued to the Entity's finance function and is referred to in
the notes to the financial statements. Determinations recorded below are the auditor's final position for
covenant-testing purposes.
1. Scope of procedures
Procedures covered the transaction population selected during the interim and final visits. They
comprised inspection of supporting documentation, enquiry of finance personnel responsible for the
original posting, and comparison against the Entity's stated accounting policies. The procedures do not
constitute an audit or a review conducted in accordance with International Standards on Auditing, and
accordingly no assurance opinion is expressed.
2. Basis of determination
Where the documentation supporting a posting was inconsistent with the classification originally
applied, the classification has been restated to the caption the supporting documentation indicates.
Where the evidence was inconclusive, the original classification stands and is not reported here.
3. Status of this report
This report supersedes any interim schedule circulated during fieldwork. It is retained in the audit file
and released to the Entity; it is not distributed to third parties other than as required under the Entity's
financing arrangements.
4. Foreign-exchange conversion examined
Non-USD amounts are converted for covenant testing at the rate implicit in the actual settlement of the
period's transactions; no separate table of rates is maintained.
APB
1
